profile.name: Mawuli Badassou
profile.title: DevOps Engineer | AWS Certified Solutions Architect
profile.bio: DevOps Engineer with 2+ years of experience designing and automating cloud infrastructure on AWS, with a background in backend development that enables direct collaboration across engineering teams. Proficient in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and production observability. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

experience.description: Designing and automating multi-environment AWS infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and production observability.
responsibilities: Restructured and fully imported a multi-environment (dev/staging/prod) AWS infrastructure into Terraform; built a reusable modules library to standardize and accelerate infrastructure provisioning across all cloud accounts

Set up Prometheus and Grafana for production monitoring; diagnosed a critical outage by tracing a memory leak through metrics and logs, coordinated the fix with the backend team, and added service-level CPU/memory limits and alerting to prevent recurrence

Built custom Grafana dashboards tracking API Gateway metrics — request rate, response time, response size, and rate-limit violations — with threshold-based alerting to surface performance issues early
Deployed Jaeger for distributed tracing, providing end-to-end visibility into request flows across services and making latency bottlenecks and failure points traceable

Designed and validated a disaster recovery strategy: configured deletion protection, DynamoDB backups, and AWS Backup; ran a full DR simulation achieving RTO of 16 min (target: 20 min) with RPO of 24 hours
Cleared a storage crisis on production instances — from 90–93% down to 53–55% — by purging stale deployment artifacts and tightening revision retention, preventing future deployment failures
Introduced Ansible for post-provisioning configuration, automating Nginx/SSL setup, package installs, and environment variable management across environments and eliminating manual SSH access
Integrated database migration execution into the CI/CD build phase, ensuring schema changes are applied before application startup and preventing environment drift
Migrated the production email system to AWS SES and refactored the sending layer with connection pooling and parallel processing, improving throughput and removing reliability bottlenecks
Automated dev/staging environment shutdowns outside business hours, cutting compute costs by ~45–50%
achievements: Achieved RTO of 16 min (vs. 20 min target) in full DR simulation with 24h RPO
Migrated 12+ manually created AWS resources into reusable Terraform modules across dev/staging/prod
Cut compute costs by ~45–50% through scheduled non-production shutdowns
Cleared production storage from 90–93% to 53–55% utilization, preventing deployment failures
Diagnosed and resolved a critical production memory leak through Prometheus/Grafana observability

experience.description: Built backend services and contributed to full-stack delivery before transitioning into DevOps.
responsibilities: Built backend services with Python and FastAPI; supported application logic and production troubleshooting
Contributed to a full-stack Java Spring Boot and Angular project deployed on AWS
Integrated external services including Google Maps API, Paystack, Amazon S3, and Holiday API
Collaborated in an Agile/Scrum team across backend, frontend, and DevOps responsibilities
achievements: Delivered full-stack project with multiple third-party integrations
Gained hands-on experience across the stack before moving into DevOps

experience.description: Completed AWS re/Start and earned the AWS Cloud Practitioner certification while building personal and group projects.
responsibilities: Enrolled in and completed the AWS re/Start program
Earned the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification
Developed a personal project using Java Spring Boot, Angular, GraphQL, and WebSockets, deployed to AWS EC2 and Vercel
Collaborated on a group project using Agile (Scrum)

projects.title: AWS Disaster Recovery Strategy
projects.description: Designed and validated a multi-region AWS disaster-recovery posture; ran a full DR simulation hitting RTO 16 min (target 20) with RPO 24h.
projects.longDescription: Designed AmaliTech's production disaster-recovery strategy on AWS. Configured deletion protection on critical resources, DynamoDB point-in-time recovery, and AWS Backup plans. Ran an end-to-end DR simulation against the target RTO/RPO and validated recovery procedures with the engineering team, then folded the learnings back into runbooks.
highlights: RTO of 16 min in full DR simulation (target: 20 min)
Deletion protection + DynamoDB PITR + AWS Backup plans

projects.title: Multi-Environment Terraform Migration
projects.description: Restructured and fully imported the AmaliTech AWS estate (dev/staging/prod) into Terraform, with a reusable modules library across cloud accounts.
projects.longDescription: Took a heterogeneous, manually-clicked AWS estate spanning dev, staging, and production and brought it under Infrastructure-as-Code in Terraform. Built a reusable modules library that standardizes how new infrastructure is provisioned across all cloud accounts, with imports of 12+ existing resources so the state matched reality before any refactors.
highlights: Multi-environment (dev / staging / prod) under one IaC pattern
12+ manually-created AWS resources imported into Terraform
Reusable modules library shared across all cloud accounts

projects.title: Production Observability Stack
projects.description: Stood up Prometheus + Grafana + Jaeger for production; diagnosed a critical memory leak and added service-level limits and alerting to prevent recurrence.
projects.longDescription: Owned the production observability stack at AmaliTech. Set up Prometheus and Grafana for metrics-driven monitoring, then deployed Jaeger for distributed tracing across services. Used the new visibility to diagnose a critical production outage caused by a memory leak — traced through metrics and logs, coordinated the fix with the backend team, then added service-level CPU/memory limits plus alerting so the same class of failure surfaces earlier next time.
highlights: Diagnosed and resolved a critical production memory leak
Service-level CPU / memory limits + alerting in place
Latency bottlenecks now traceable across services

projects.title: API Gateway Performance Dashboards
projects.description: Custom Grafana dashboards tracking request rate, response time, response size, and rate-limit violations with threshold-based alerting.
projects.longDescription: Built a set of custom Grafana dashboards on top of API Gateway telemetry — request rate, response time, response size, and rate-limit violations — and wired threshold-based alerting so performance regressions are surfaced before they become incidents. Used in production to investigate spikes and validate releases.
highlights: Tracks request rate, response time, response size, rate-limit violations
Used during incident investigation and release validation

projects.title: AWS SES Email Migration
projects.description: Migrated the production email system to AWS SES and refactored the sending layer with connection pooling and parallel processing.
projects.longDescription: Owned the migration of the production email system to AWS SES. Beyond the lift-and-shift, refactored the sending layer to use connection pooling and parallel processing, removing throughput bottlenecks and improving reliability of transactional and bulk email flows.
highlights: Migrated production email to AWS SES
Connection pooling + parallel processing in sending layer

projects.title: Non-Production Cost Reduction
projects.description: Automated dev/staging environment shutdowns outside business hours, cutting compute costs by ~45–50%.
projects.longDescription: Wrote and operationalized automation that shuts down dev and staging environments outside business hours and brings them back up before the workday. Took compute spend down ~45–50% on non-production environments without affecting developer productivity.
highlights: Automated start/stop on a business-hours schedule

projects.title: CI/CD-Integrated DB Migrations
projects.description: Integrated database migration execution into the CI/CD build phase so schema changes are applied before application startup, preventing environment drift.
projects.longDescription: Reworked the deployment pipeline so database migrations are applied during the CI/CD build phase, before application startup. Closed a long-standing drift problem where schema changes could lag the application that depended on them, and gave teams a single, reliable contract for shipping schema + code together.
highlights: Schema changes applied before application startup
Single contract for shipping schema + code together

projects.title: Personal Portfolio
projects.description: This site — an Angular 17 terminal-themed portfolio, data-driven from a single JSON.
projects.longDescription: The site you're looking at. Built with Angular 17 standalone components; everything is data-driven from a single JSON file consumed via a typed service. Linux/terminal aesthetic with custom cursor, keyboard navigation, and per-section terminal chrome.
highlights: Terminal / CRT aesthetic with custom cursor
Theme switcher (green / amber / blue) with localStorage persistence
